{{infobox Chinese|l=Yang Wood Monkey|kanji=甲申|romaji=kinoe saru|onyomi=kōshin|p=jiǎshēn|w=chia-shen|mi=ʈ͡ʂja̠²¹ ʂən|y=gaap6 san1|j=gaap6 san1|ci=kaːp̚ ʂɐn|mc=kæp ʂin|oc-bs=kaːp ʔʂin}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Wood Monkey''' (甲申, ''kinoe saru''; onyomi ''kōshin'') is the 21st of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 21st of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Water Goat|ja|癸未|1=Yin Water Goat}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Wood Rooster|ja|乙酉|1=Yin Wood Rooster}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''甲'' is Yang Wood, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''申'' (Monkey) is Yang Metal; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Wood Monkey (甲申)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): jiǎshēn
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gaap3 san1
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kinoe-saru
*** On'yomi: kōshin
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gap sin (갑신)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Giáp Thân

==Months of Yang Wood Monkey==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era|1=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 0 or 5 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems|1=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kou|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kou}} or {{ill|Otsu|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otsu}}), the month of {{ill|July|en|July|qid=Q121|lt=July|1=July}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)|1=Month}} of {{ill|Koushin|ja|甲申|1=Yang Wood Monkey|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Koushin|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Lunisolar|ja|旧暦|1=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term|1=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Liqiu|en|Liqiu|qid=Q1147421|lt=Beginning of Autumn|1=Liqiu}} until the day before {{ill|Bailu (solar term)|en|Bailu (solar term)|qid=Q1191003|lt=White Dew|1=Bailu (solar term)}}) as applicable.
